_about: Single source of truth for index.html and capability-statement.html. Edit here, then run: python3 scripts/build.py. Every value traces to docs/SOURCE_FACTS.md (SAM.gov record) or the owner record of 2026-11-13.

site.title: Victory Arms Company LLC | SBA-Certified SDVOSB | Tactical Equipment, Weapon Accessories and Ammunition Supply
site.description: Victory Arms Company LLC is an SBA-certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business in Jacksonville, NC. Tactical equipment, weapon accessories and ammunition supplied by resale and distribution to DLA and federal agencies. UEI ZZQAKXV8EJ41, CAGE 02S54.

copy.headline: Tactical Equipment, Weapon Accessories & Ammunition Supply
copy.subhead: SBA-certified SDVOSB supplying DLA and federal agency requirements by resale and distribution. Located in Jacksonville, NC, outside MCB Camp Lejeune.
copy.overview: Victory Arms Company LLC is an SBA-certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business in Jacksonville, North Carolina, outside MCB Camp Lejeune. VAC supplies tactical equipment, weapon accessories and small-arms ammunition to federal buyers by resale and distribution, and quotes DLA requirements through DIBBS.

competencies.title: Weapon Accessories & Maintenance
bullets: Weapon carry cases, drag bags and hard cases
Cleaning kits, cleaning rods and maintenance items
Small-arms accessories and replacement items quoted to the NSN and part number

competencies.title: Ammunition & Range Supply
bullets: Small-arms ammunition (PSC 1305), supplied by resale and distribution
Training ammunition, targets and range consumables

competencies.title: Federal Supply Quoting
bullets: Electronic quotes on DLA Land and Maritime and DLA Troop Support RFQs
Commercial items quoted to SDVOSB set-asides, small-business set-asides and full-and-open RFQs
Each quote priced to the RFQ's part number, quantity and delivery date

differentiators.title: Veteran-Led
differentiators.text: Led by a U.S. Marine Corps veteran with direct experience in weapons, ammunition and equipment accountability for operating and training units.

differentiators.title: Set-Aside Eligible
differentiators.text: SBA-certified SDVOSB and VOSB. Eligible for SDVOSB, VOSB and small-business set-asides.

differentiators.title: Domestic & Allied Sourcing
differentiators.text: Domestic and allied sourcing only. No hardware, optics, electronics or software from China, Russia, Iran or North Korea.

differentiators.title: One Point of Contact
differentiators.text: Every quote is priced and signed by the owner, who stays the contact from RFQ to delivery.

copy.direction: Company direction: building toward domestic, automated production capacity for critical defense needs.
